title: Benchmark disk write performance
summary: Test how fast your disk can write data by creating a large file filled with zeros. This helps measure storage speed.

steps.explain: Write a large file of zeros to the disk to measure write speed. Replace <BLOCK_SIZE> (e.g., 1024), <COUNT> (e.g., 1000000), and <OUTPUT_FILE> (e.g., ~/testfile.bin). The total size is BLOCK_SIZE * COUNT.

placeholders.name: BLOCK_SIZE
placeholders.description: Size of each block in bytes

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the temporary file to create

steps.expect: The command will output statistics including the total time and transfer rate.
